rule_config.edge_rule: flag a visible prediction when its first broad-vial liquid row is within one surface-oval height of the holder band's top edge
rule_config.hidden_range_check: manifest geometry row contained by predicted row range
rule_config.hidden_rule: call hidden when liquid is visible within one validation-derived surface-oval height below the fixed holder band and no liquid is visible within that height above the band; return the holder band widened at both ends by the surface-oval height

hidden_rule_derivation.surface_oval_eligibility: positive-level validation frame without foam or sticker, with the first surface-width window clear of the frame-specific holder band and label top within two rows of manifest geometry
hidden_rule_derivation.surface_oval_height_statistic: upper coverage order statistic of first maximum-width liquid row
hidden_rule_derivation.visibility_column_derivation: intersection of validation label-mask vial-outline columns

rule_config.hidden_supplemental_error: distance from label-mask liquid top to the nearest predicted range endpoint

measurement_row_derivation.outline_rule: intersection of per-frame centre-band intervals after the contiguous top blocked nozzle span and before the contiguous bottom blocked base span

rule_config.truth_source: top liquid row from the validation label mask
rule_config.visible_row_rule: first row with minimum liquid pixels in the measurement columns and frozen vial-interior row interval

hidden.metric: ground-truth-hidden frames called hidden with true level in range

visible_p95.metric: p95 absolute error in mL from row error / 3.04

visible_typical.metric: median absolute error in mL from row error / 3.04
